outcome: Predictive capacity for small for gestational age (SGA) newborns
Area under the curve (AUC) for predictive models
cohort: The study involved 12,912 cases from a retrospective cohort of births assisted at a Spanish hospital.
finding: The study found that a combined model integrating maternal characteristics and biochemical markers with third-trimester ultrasound improved the detection rate of SGA newborns compared to ultrasound alone.
birth_weight: Birth weight for gestational age < 10th percentile (SGA)
